#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    std::istringstream iss(line);
    int n;
    std::string s;
    iss >> n >> s;

    bool inside = false;
    int insideCount = 0, maxOutside = 0, wordLen = 0;

    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == '(') {
            maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, wordLen);
            wordLen = 0;
            inside = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inside = false;
            if (wordLen > 0) {
                insideCount++;
                wordLen = 0;
            }
        } else if (c == '_') {
            if (inside && wordLen > 0) {
                insideCount++;
            } else if (!inside) {
                maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, wordLen);
            }
            wordLen = 0;
        } else {
            wordLen++;
        }
    }
    maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, wordLen);
    std::cout << maxOutside << " " << insideCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
